context: Dr. Saito does a house-call check on Mrs. Mori's minor knee trouble. She has tea ready, naturally.
purpose: gentle home medical visit — long-known patient receiving careful in-home attention

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: お邪魔します。今日は訪問診療で。
lines.en: Excuse the intrusion. Today's a home visit.
lines.style: Doctor warm professional opener, the home-call register softer than clinic, soft real respect threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: 先生、わざわざ。お茶どうぞ。
lines.en: Doctor, all the way out here. Have some tea.
lines.style: Neighbor warm hosting greeting, the routine community-hospitality, soft real appreciation threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。膝の調子はどうですか。
lines.en: Thank you. How's your knee feeling?
lines.style: Doctor warm professional pivot to work, the gentle careful inquiry, soft real attention threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: うーん、階段はきついわ。
lines.style: Neighbor honest specific complaint, the daily-life detail offered plainly, soft real candor threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 階段ですか。痛みは、いつ強くなりますか。
lines.en: Stairs, I see. When does the pain get worse?
lines.style: Doctor professional careful follow-up, the clinical precision delivered with warmth, soft real attention threading throughout.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: 朝が一番つらいの。動かし始める時。
lines.en: Mornings are worst. When I start moving.
lines.style: Neighbor warm specific recall, the practical patient-reporting honest, soft real engagement threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: なるほど。無理しないことが、まず大事です。
lines.en: I see. First, not pushing yourself is what matters.
lines.style: Doctor warm gentle wisdom-instruction, the professional kindness audible, soft real care threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: はい、気をつけます。来てもらえて安心したわ。
lines.en: Yes, I'll be careful. I'm relieved you came.
lines.style: Neighbor warm closing gratitude, the home-visit relief audible, soft real appreciation threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: また来週、様子見に伺いますね。
lines.en: I'll come by next week to check on you again.
lines.style: Doctor warm professional follow-up promise, the home-care commitment audible, soft real care threading throughout delivery.
